title: Tensor compatibility of the etale/pro-etale open-extension comparison
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion] and $A$ a finite discrete commutative ring. Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module-sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], comparison inverse images $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $e=j_!^{et}$, $d=j_!^{pro}$, $r=j_{et}^{-1}$, $s=j_{pro}^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Let $a:C_Ur\xrightarrow{\sim}sC_X$ be the canonical pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and let $c:C_Xe\xrightarrow{\sim}dC_U$ be the unit-normalized canonical open comparison [lem-sf-open-comparison-unit-normalization]. All tensors below are ordinary sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $t^T_{V,W}:C_T(V\otimes_A W)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_TV\otimes_A C_TW$ for the canonical tensor comparison, induced by inverse image and the constant-ring identification.

For $F\in\operatorname{Mod}(U_{et},A)$ and $B\in\operatorname{Mod}(X_{et},A)$, let $\kappa^e_{F,B}:e(F\otimes_A rB)\to eF\otimes_A B$ be the $e\dashv r$ transpose of $\eta^e_F\otimes1$ under the restriction-tensor comparison, and define $\kappa^d_{G,H}:d(G\otimes_A sH)\to dG\otimes_A H$ by the same open-unit prescription on the pro-etale site. Then
$$
(c_F\otimes1)\circ t^X_{eF,B}\circ C_X(\kappa^e_{F,B})
=\kappa^d_{C_UF,C_XB}\circ d\bigl((1\otimes a_B)\circ t^U_{F,rB}\bigr)\circ c_{F\otimes_A rB}.
$$
Both sides have source $C_Xe(F\otimes_A rB)$ and target $dC_UF\otimes_A C_XB$. The equality is natural in both $F$ and $B$.

proof.text: For monoidal functors T and R and a monoidal natural transformation a, precompose with the invertible lax tensor map of T. The monoidality equation for a and the inverse identities for lax and oplax tensor maps give a_(V tensor W) delta_R = delta_T (a_V tensor a_W). Apply this to the inverse canonical comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso, which is monoidal by the proved source-library instance isMonoidal_comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso_hom. Expand the canonical localization transports defining the restriction tensor maps and openComparisonRestrictionIso. Naturality of the two localization isomorphisms, their inverse identities and the displayed monoidality equation prove the restriction tensor coherence square. This replaces the generic ringed-module pure-pairing route by the existing monoidal API.

proof.text: Put N = F tensor rB. By the open unit normalization, the pro-etale transpose of c_N inverse followed by h is C(eta_N) followed by a_(eN) then s(h). Apply this to the left composite. Naturality of the transported restriction tensor map moves s(c_F tensor identity) to the right. Naturality of a and the restriction tensor coherence square move C(r(kappa_e)) next to C(eta_N). The defining transpose equation for kappa_e identifies eta_N r(kappa_e) rho_e with eta_F tensor identity. Naturality of the oplax tensor comparison and unit normalization at F give t_U followed by eta_(C F) tensor a_B.

proof.text: Precompose both proposed maps with c_N inverse, apply the pro-etale open Hom bijection and postcompose with rho_d. For the right composite cancel the extension comparison, use homEquiv_naturality_left and Equiv.apply_symm_apply for the defining kappa_d transpose, and use tensor interchange. Its image is t_U followed by eta_(C F) tensor a_B, the same as the preceding step. Cancel rho_d, use injectivity of the Hom bijection and cancel c_N inverse.

proof.text: Prove naturality of the etale restriction tensor comparison from the localization isomorphism naturality and OplaxMonoidal.delta_natural. Transpose both kappa_e naturality composites using the etale open adjunction, cancel rho_e, and use naturality of its unit and tensor interchange. Apply comparison and compose with delta_natural and naturality of c to obtain simultaneous naturality of the left composite.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q65-d3668d4f6 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item, all six steps and every cited node statement, and re-derived each step: it is a correct agent-written proof with no new nodes and no fixes. The statement is unchanged and well typed; both sides go from C_X e(F⊗rB) to dC_UF⊗C_XB. Coefficients are ordinary constant-A modules with A finite, so no base-change morphism or other coefficient category is involved. Step 1: the unit normalization at N gives Ψ(h)=s(h c_N^{-1})η^d, and d⊣s comes from lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact once lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization identifies the site; def-weil-extension-by-zero defines d by exactly that presheaf. So Ψ is injective without faithfulness of s. Step 2: I checked the tensor square (*) from product naturality of a, the pure-tensor values in lem-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image-tensor-comparison (applied to the transported projections, with lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact clause 1), and the rule in def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus that pure pairings determine linear maps. Marking it elementary is acceptable. Steps 3-4: both sides reduce to ρ^dΨ = (η^d_{C_UF}⊗a_B)t^U, using the transpose equations for κ^e and κ^d and the unit normalization at F and at N; the orientations are correct. Steps 5-6 (cancellation and naturality) are fine, and proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. Sources: Stacks proetale.tex Tag 09AF (lemma-jshriek-comparison, l.5076) is only the adjoint argument, so proof_origin=agent is right; sites-modules Tag 03EL (l.3649) gives the bilinear-pairing route; the blueprint main-20261015 final pro-etale paragraph of lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula is the recorded place. Small cases checked: j=id, U empty, F=0, B=0, A=0. Duplicate search: lem-pur-open-projection-site-transport is a derived statement for locally free shifted F only, and lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization is pro-etale-only base change; neither is a duplicate. There is no cycle and no SGA. I accept the seven declared tool uses: lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction, lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor, lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact clause 1 only, lem-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image-tensor-comparison and lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback. Details are in review.md.

lean.statement: theorem openComparison_tensor_normalization (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] : (∀ (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (B : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)), openComparisonTensorLeft A j F B = openComparisonTensorRight A j F B) ∧ (∀ {F F' : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)} {B B' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)} (f : F ⟶ F') (b : B ⟶ B'), (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).map ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).map (f ⊗ₘ (Etale.openImmersionRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).map b)) ≫ openComparisonTensorLeft A j F' B' = openComparisonTensorLeft A j F B ≫ ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).map ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) U).map f) ⊗ₘ (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).map b))
